clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da sola con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Giada era nella 1ª colonna e nella 2ª riga, ma non era accanto a un pupazzo di neve.
clues.en: Giada was in the 1st column and in the 2nd row, but was not beside a snowman.

clues.it: Fabio era a nord di Ugo e nella Stalla delle Renne.
clues.en: Fabio was north of Ugo and in the Reindeer Stable.

clues.it: Carla era nella 4ª colonna, accanto a un regalo e nella Stalla delle Renne.
clues.en: Carla was in the 4th column, beside a present and in the Reindeer Stable.

clues.it: Dario era in una stanza diversa da Anna e da solo in Salotto, ma non era accanto a una calza.
clues.en: Dario was in a different room from Anna and alone in the Parlor, but was not beside a stocking.

clues.it: Vito era nella 8ª colonna e accanto a una sedia a dondolo, ma non era accanto a dei nastri.
clues.en: Vito was in the 8th column and beside a rocking chair, but was not beside loose ribbons.

clues.it: Irene era nella 7ª riga e in una stanza diversa da Dario.
clues.en: Irene was in the 7th row and in a different room from Dario.

clues.it: Anna era in una stanza diversa da Dario e nella Cucina dei Biscotti.
clues.en: Anna was in a different room from Dario and in the Cookie Kitchen.

clues.it: Ugo era nella 6ª colonna, nella 9ª riga e a ovest di Vito.
clues.en: Ugo was in the 6th column, in the 9th row and west of Vito.

general_clues.en: 4 in the west half of the grid.
4 in the north half of the grid.

general_clues.it: 1 accanto a un cumulo di neve.
2 accanto a una sedia a dondolo.

steps.it: Solo Elena può stare nella 1ª riga: per tutti gli altri è esclusa, quindi la casella in colonna 9ª è sua.
steps.en: Elena is the only one who can be in the 1st row: every other suspect is ruled out of it, so the square in column 9th is theirs.

steps.it: L'indizio di Giada lascia una sola casella libera: riga 2ª, colonna 1ª.
steps.en: Giada's own clue leaves a single free square: row 2nd, column 1st.
